sources.title: 1 Introduction
sources.snippet: 1.1 Course Match The state-of-the-art practical solution to the course allocation problem is the Course Match (CM)mechanism by Budish et al. (2017), which provides a good trade-off between efficiency, fairness, and incentives.

sources.title: Machine Learning-Powered Course Allocation - ACM Digital Library
sources.snippet: We study the course allocation problem, where universities assign course schedules to students. The current state-of-the-art mechanism, Course Match, has one major shortcoming: students make significant mistakes when reporting their preferences, which negatively affects welfare and fairness. To address this issue, we introduce a new mechanism, Machine Learning-powered Course Match (MLCM). At ...

sources.title: Machine learning-driven dynamic matching of industry ... - Springer
sources.snippet: This research examines the industry-education alignment literature, suggests a machine learning based system of dynamic matching of skills to courses, and illustrates successful curriculum adjustment. Findings confirm better alignment with industry needs, and future work includes real-time input and sector-specific course recommendations.
